name: typed search query returns an exact match
looks: A headline pairs a bold word with an italic accent word above a clean search bar. A query types itself into the bar, a small result count and filter caption appear beneath, then the scene cuts to a single connected result card zooming into frame.
build: glass-ui-flow: a search input with a blinking caret typing the query (kit.typeOn), a result row fading/sliding in once typing completes, then a hard cut to a DOM card entering on a spring with a slight scale-up.
sound: A soft typing clack per character, a light blip as the result count appears, a whoosh on the card cut.
prompt: Show a short headline above a clean search bar as a query types itself in, with a small exact-match count appearing under it. Cut to a single result card springing into frame to prove the search actually found something specific.
